balloons.text: ACT 3 GRAND FINALE — THE THRONE CHAMBER OF LORD MALCODE'S CITADEL.
FOOLISH GUARDIANS! MY INFINITE CORRUPTION WILL ERASE PYTHONIA FOREVER!
CODE-GRAVITY OVERRIDE!! LET'S SEE YOU STAND IN FOUR FRACTURED REALMS!!
A violet gravity ring shatters the obsidian floor into four drifting islands!
ABOVE THE HALL, THE GUARDIANS' STAGE-3 PARTNERS UNLEASH A CELESTIAL VORTEX!
HOLD ON, VEX!! I'VE GOT YOU!!
KAI?! YOU ACTUALLY DOVE INTO THE CHASM FOR ME?!
FIRE, FROST, AND STARLIGHT MERGE INTO ONE UNSTOPPABLE SPELL STREAM!
BRUTE FORCE ONLY DOUBLES MY RECURSIVE PRISM BARRIER!!
NGH!! MY LOTUS SHIELD IS CRACKING!!
The reflected blast slams Kai and Ember onto a crumbling spire!
A GRAVITY DOME SEALED US IN!!
Tempest Stag, brace the spire—don't let it tilt!
THE LEDGE IS SPLITTING! BARKLEY, HOLD THE LOTUS DOME!!
Yi Ren, stay inside the flame ring!
CODE-VINES ARE EVERYWHERE! JAVIN JR, RAISE BAMBOO SHIELD!!
Hold tight, Squad 3—our emerald barrier is holding!
Echo-glitch clones! OKX, scan their frequency!
Back to back, Squad 4! Don't let them break our formation!
Wait... look at that pulsing emerald seam under his chestplate! His core is fighting the armor?!
The Mirror-Sage's True Mirror Shard! It's pointing straight at his heart!
The crystal from Chapter 11 hums with warm golden-emerald truth.
ALL FOUR SQUADS!! STOP USING BRUTE FORCE!!
DEBUG HIS FOUR GRAVITY PILLARS WITH CLEAN CODE!!
BARKLEY! LIGHT UP HIS DARKNESS!
SYLVAN-FOX, EMERALD ROOT SHIELD—HOLD THE LINE!
STICKY, MIMIK-SPARK, MIKU, AND EMERALD-X LOCK SHIELDS AGAINST MALCODE'S BEAM!
OKX, DAN, DOYB, AND STAR-YARN CATICORN WEAVE A FOUR-CORNER LOGIC SEAL!

balloons.text: TEMPEST STAG! RING THE AURORA BELL—BREAK HIS SHIELD!
EVERY GUARDIAN—SYNC YOUR RELICS NOW!
BRO! IGNITE THE FLAME ROPE! SKY-PUP, THREAD THE LIGHTNING RINGS!!
DOYB locked the trajectory—Ignis-Frost thermal surge and Poppy petal heal, FIRE!!
STICKY, CLEAR THE MIST! EMERALD-X, ECO-RESTORATION WAVE!!
Miku, silence the static! Caticorn, weave our 17-thread rainbow bridge!!
ENOUGH!! SWARM THEM, VOID-RIFT DRONES!! TEAR THEM APART!!
Cornered, Malcode rips open a ceiling rift—a hundred glitch-drones pour down!
SUDDENLY—EMERALD DAWN SHATTERS THE CEILING RIFT!!
The four Purified Realm Guardians from Chapters 9, 10 & 11 descend in glory!
You freed our hearts, young Guardians! Now we hold the sky—go free the heart inside Malcode!!
REALM I CONVERGENCE: Aurora Prism Sky shatters Gravity Pillar 1!
REALM II CONVERGENCE: Sun-Forge & Tide melts Gravity Pillar 2 into steam!
REALM III CONVERGENCE: Elder-Grove Blossom seals Gravity Pillar 3 in jade vines!
REALM IV CONVERGENCE: Celestial Starlight decrypts Pillar 4—gravity restores!
ALL FOUR PILLARS ARE DOWN!!
NOW, VEX!! WHILE HIS FIREWALL IS OPEN—LET'S REACH HIS CORE!!
IMPOSSIBLE!! SEVENTEEN TINY CODERS CANNOT OVERRIDE MY INFINITE LOOP!!

code_tray.concept: Stopping an Infinite while Loop with break
lines: break  # 17-Guardian Unity snaps the infinite loop!
code_tray.output: ALERT: 17 Relic Signals Detected -> Infinite Loop BROKEN!

balloons.text: YOU UNLEASHED THE STATIC STORM BECAUSE NOBODY WANTED YOU, VEX!! RETURN TO THE DARK!!
Maybe he's right... I broke Pythonia... I don't deserve friends...
Tears fall onto the Silver Backdoor Key as darkness closes in.
STOP LISTENING TO HIM!! YOU'RE SAN JIE CLASS NOW, VEX!!
Hands linked—nobody gets left alone ever again!
FLASHBACK — Original Penang pencil sketches (#01, #04, #10, #17) ignite in gold!
"Remember why we drew them—for kindness!" (#02, #03, #06, #11)
"Zero weapons. 100% plant-based. Three Hearts!" (#05, #07, #13, #14)
All 17 sketches burst into starlight—shattering the Zero-Point chains! (#08, #09, #12, #15, #16)
TRUE MIRROR SHARD—REVEAL WHAT'S TRULY INSIDE HIM!!
WAIT—THERE'S A REAL PERSON TRAPPED INSIDE THAT ARMOR?!
Through the golden beam, a kind figure with glasses holds back the dark chains from within!
He was protecting us from inside all along!! KAI—BOOST ME UP!!
EMBER—WIND SPIRAL! LOTUS STEPPING SHIELDS—GO, VEX!!
I'M GOING IN!!
SILVER BACKDOOR KEY—BREAK THE INFINITE LOOP!!
SQUAD ONE—AURORA BELL, IRON HEART, DYNAMO, AND SOLAR COMPASS!
ALL FOUR SIGNALS LOCKED AND RISING!
SQUAD TWO—HEARTH FLAME, TWIN BALANCE, STAR COMPASS, AND BLOSSOM DEW!
OUR LIGHT WILL GUIDE EVERY LOST SPARK HOME!
SQUAD THREE—TIDE, BAMBOO AEGIS, STAR-BERRY, ROOT, AND ECO-RUNE!
FIVE GUARDIANS STRONG—UNBREAKABLE DEFENSE!
SQUAD FOUR—CIPHER CUBE, STITCH-LIGHT, MOON CHIMES, AND NEBULA YARN!
WEAVING ALL SEVENTEEN THREADS INTO ONE RAINBOW CODE!
SEVENTEEN GUARDIAN STREAMS CONVERGE ON HERO KAI'S EMERALD CORE.
ALL SEVENTEEN VALUES VERIFIED! EXECUTING: GRAND HARMONY RETURN!!
The dark Void-Parasite dissolves into harmless emerald butterflies!!
Golden sunlight floods the ruined hall as the obsidian armor begins to fracture!
FIRST, A FRACTURE OF EMERALD LIGHT SPLITS THE OBSIDIAN GREAVES...
THEN THE DARK GAUNTLETS DISSOLVE INTO LEAVES, UNCOVERING A WARM HUMAN HAND...
AS THE LAST SHADOWS DISSIPATE, A FAMILIAR FACE APPEARS—SLEEPING IN TRANQUIL PEACE...
WAIT—THAT'S TEACHER CHEONG!!
HOW COME HE WAS INSIDE MALCODE?!
LOOK OUT, CLASS! THAT VOID-PARASITE IS LUNGING INTO THE PORTAL!!
FLASHBACK (1/4): Back in Penang, the rogue Void-Parasite ambushed the class mid-transit!
RUN TO THE FOUR REALMS!! I'LL HOLD THE BREACH!!
FLASHBACK (2/4): Teacher Cheong shielded his students so all 17 landed safely!
FLASHBACK (3/4): The parasite wrapped him in obsidian armor as a puppet shell, sealing his heart asleep...
NO!! TEACHER CHEONG!!
Hold back... I won't let this armor hurt a single one of my students... I trust you all...
FLASHBACK (4/4): From inside the dark core, Teacher Cheong secretly dampened every blow!
WHEN THE GLITCH STORM STRUCK PYTHONIA, I STEPPED IN TO SHIELD OUR CLASS—
MALCODE'S DARKNESS WRAPPED AROUND ME LIKE ARMOR, WAITING FOR SEVENTEEN KIND HEARTS AND CLEAN CODE TO FREE ME.
A RADIANT EMERALD SEED RISES FROM TEACHER CHEONG'S HEART INTO HIS PALMS...
TAKE THIS SEED OF KINDNESS, VEX—LET IT SHOW YOU THE GENTLE WAY WE HUMANS SHOULD LIVE.
FOR ME...? EVEN AFTER EVERYTHING I DID... THANK YOU.
My real-world body in Penang is holding the classroom gate open. I must return first so you can come home at dawn!
His silhouette shimmers like golden morning dew beside the Penang classroom portal.
TEACHER CHEONG IS SO PROUD OF YOU ALL! MAY YOU ALL SPREAD THE SEEDS OF KINDNESS TO THE WORLD.
DON'T WORRY ABOUT ME... WE WILL MEET BACK IN OUR REAL WORLD...
LOOK, VEX... TEACHER CHEONG'S KINDNESS SEED IS BLOOMING INTO A PURE EMERALD SPROUT!
I PROMISE TO NURTURE IT ACROSS PYTHONIA. THANK YOU FOR BELIEVING IN ME, KAI.
Thank you, San Jie Guardians! Our Four Realms shine again because of your kindness!
As dawn breaks, the four Purified Realm Guardians bow gratefully before returning home.
DAWN BREAKS OVER A RESTORED PYTHONIA. EVERY REALM SHINES BRIGHT AND BUG-FREE.
WE REALLY DID IT, EMBER... EVERY SINGLE GUARDIAN SHONE LIKE A STAR.
IN THE SUNLIT COURTYARD, THE STAGE-3 GUARDIAN PARTNERS DANCE IN GOLDEN PETALS!
I'M RECORDING EVERY GUARDIAN'S LESSON SO FUTURE CODERS NEVER FORGET THEM.
SKETCHING OUR ADVENTURE, VEX? EVEN EMBER WANTS TO CHECK YOUR NOTES!
MEANWHILE, THE GUARDIAN PARTNERS HOST THEIR OWN 100% PLANT-BASED TEA PARTY!
THE GRAND VICTORY FEAST — ALL SEVENTEEN SAN JIE GUARDIANS AROUND ONE TABLE!
A TOAST TO TEACHER CHEONG AND SAN JIE CLASS—SEVENTEEN HEARTS, ONE LEGEND!
TO SQUAD ONE! FROM FROST-PEAK CLIFFS ALL THE WAY TO THE CITADEL!
AND THESE PLANT-BASED STEAMED BUNS BEAT EVEN MY DYNAMO CORE!
LOOK AT THESE FRUIT TARTS AND DUMPLINGS—WE EARNED EVERY BITE!
MY COMPASS SAYS THIS IS THE HAPPIEST COORDINATE IN PYTHONIA.
CHEERS, SQUAD THREE! STICKY WOULD LOVE THIS WATERFALL TEA!
EVERY GUARDIAN KEPT THEIR PROMISE. ZERO BUGS LEFT STANDING!
TO SQUAD FOUR! EVEN THE FLOATING LIBRARY RUNES ARE CHEERING TONIGHT!
ONE MORE STEAMED BUN, SHI YE—WE'VE GOT LANTERNS TO LIGHT NEXT!
AFTER THE FEAST, HERO KAI SUMMONS SEVENTEEN GOLDEN SCROLLS OF PYTHONIA.
ONE SCROLL FOR EVERY GUARDIAN—SEALED WITH YOUR COURAGE, KINDNESS, AND CODE!

balloons.text: LANTERN NIGHT — UNDER THE AURORA SKY, EVERY GUARDIAN MAKES A WISH.
LIGHT YOUR LANTERNS, EVERYONE! LET OUR WISHES RISE HIGHER THAN THE STARS!
HIGH ABOVE THE VALLEY, THE GUARDIAN PARTNERS DANCE AMONG RISING LANTERNS!
I WISH WE NEVER STOP LEARNING AND CREATING TOGETHER!
AND THAT OUR FRIENDSHIP GROWS LIKE THE DEEPEST EMERALD ROOTS!
UP THEY GO! EVERY LANTERN CARRIES CLEAN CODE INTO THE NIGHT!
IT LOOKS LIKE A RAINBOW CONSTELLATION MADE JUST FOR SAN JIE CLASS!
LOOK HOW BRIGHT THE AURORA IS TONIGHT—JUST LIKE TEMPEST STAG'S WINGS!
WHEREVER OUR COMPASS POINTS NEXT, WE'LL ALWAYS BE SEVENTEEN GUARDIANS.
THREE, TWO, ONE—RELEASE!
FLY HIGH, LITTLE LANTERNS! CARRY OUR THANK-YOU ALL THE WAY HOME!
Hundreds of golden wish-lanterns rise into the cosmos—carrying seventeen promises of kindness!
THE NEXT MORNING, A GOLDEN PORTAL OPENS TO CARRY SAN JIE CLASS BACK HOME.
YOU DON'T NEED MAGIC SCROLLS TO BE HEROES—YOUR KINDNESS AND LOGIC GO HOME WITH YOU!
Thank you for everything, Tempest Stag and BARKLEY... we'll never forget you!
Poppy, Miku—keep shining bright in Pythonia!
Whenever you draw or code with love, we're right here beside you!
Sticky, OKX, Caticorn & Sky-Pup nuzzle their trainers one last time before the sunrise gate.
HIGH FIVE, HERO KAI! WE'LL KEEP CODING BACK IN SAN JIE CLASS!
TAKE CARE OF KAI FOR US, EMBER... WE'LL MISS YOU SO MUCH!
BACK IN SAN JIE CLASS — JULY 2026. THE SUN SHINES ON SEVENTEEN FOREVER GUARDIANS.
SAME CLASSROOM... NEW SUPERPOWERS! WHO'S READY TO WRITE OUR NEXT PYTHON PROGRAM?
WELCOME BACK, SAN JIE CLASS—I TOLD YOU WE'D MEET AGAIN IN OUR REAL WORLD!
TEACHER CHEONG!!
On every wooden desk in Penang, seventeen original pencil sketchbooks shimmer faintly with emerald starlight...
STRING!! GRANDMA LOOMA!! WE'RE HOME!!
Welcome home, little Kai! Our forest is blooming again!
Back at Loom Forest Cottage, String leaps into Kai's arms as Grandma Looma smiles on the porch!
Look, Teacher Cheong... your Seed of Kindness grew into an Emerald Tree watching over all of Pythonia.
On the sunlit hill above the valley, Vex stands guard with a peaceful smile.
UNTIL OUR NEXT ADVENTURE, SAN JIE CLASS—KEEP CODING WITH KINDNESS!!
YOUR SEVENTEEN SCROLLS WILL SHINE OVER PYTHONIA FOREVER!
FIN — HERO KAI × SAN JIE 17 GUARDIANS (JULY 2026). THANK YOU FOR READING!
